name: Stormnexus Ritual
description: A spell perhaps as old as the Multiverse that calls forth the soul of Tarkir and bound spirit dragons to the new clan leaders.

description_citations.text: "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai begin raiding the Ukud Necropolis vaults.
timeline.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai began raiding its vaults.

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo leads the rebellion against Kolaghan and becomes Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual.
timeline.quote: In the current timeline, he led the Mardu rebellion against Kolaghan and became Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual .

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stormnexus Ritual unleashes a dragonstorm in the Crucible; the dragonlords fall to new spirit dragons.
timeline.quote: The dragonlords fell, freeing Tarkir’s clans

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Five Spirit Dragons appear during the Stormnexus Ritual to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons.
timeline.quote: five additional Spirit Dragons appeared on Tarkir to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Spirit Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset finds the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and is convinced by rebellion leaders to use it.
timeline.quote: she was convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual raises five spirit dragons, who battle the Dragonlords; the Dragonlords are defeated and seemingly swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: In the end, the Dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid, the rebels defeat the dragonlord and take power.
timeline.quote: they fought and defeated the dragonlord, installing themselves in power

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset is persuaded to use the Stormnexus Ritual.
timeline.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Spirit dragons defeat the dragonlords, who are swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset uncovers and puts into action the Stormnexus Ritual, leading to the final defeat of the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: She was convinced to put it into action by the other rebellion leaders, leading to the final defeat of the dragonlords.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Revival of the Jeskai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: In the end, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

timeline.summary: Narset and clan leaders perform the Stormnexus Ritual, giving rise to Spirit Dragons that defeat the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were driven into the tempests and disappeared

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Desparked". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset is convinced to use the Stormnexus Ritual, raising a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons.
timeline.quote: five mighty spirit dragons emerged

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dragonlords, Silumgar included, are defeated by the spirit dragons and swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and is persuaded to use it.
timeline.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual raises a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons; the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated by the clan leaders and their spirit dragons and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual reactivates the dragonstorms, which spiral out of control.
timeline.quote: the spell had also reactivated the dragonstorms.

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam helps Sarkhan cast a corrupted Stormnexus Ritual, giving him control of the wild dragons.
timeline.quote: Taigam helped Sarkhan cast a corrupted form of the Stormnexus Ritual

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Ending the outbreaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Alniul's help Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and, persuaded by rebellion leaders, agrees to use it.
timeline.quote: convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir

citation.text: "Narset", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual calls up a massive dragonstorm from which five spirit dragons emerge and bind to the clan leaders; the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated by the clan leaders and their spirit dragons

citation.text: "Narset", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset and Alniul find the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and Narset is persuaded by the other rebellion leaders to use it.
timeline.quote: was convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon the ritual calls up a dragonstorm; Narset leaps onto a spirit and shapes it, and the dragon spirits are bound to the new clan leaders.
timeline.quote: In a flash of power, the dragon spirits and what would become the new clan leaders were bound.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual, the elder dragonlords are replaced by five new spirit dragons, and a new breed of dragons pours out through dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual , the elder dragonlords have been replaced by five new spirit dragons .
